title: director.launch/1
description: data/director/launch.json: the launch planner's landing-mix numbers (sim/director/launch.gd; docs/director/landing-mix.md). SLAM DOWN is a drive (down and forward, at an angle set by the target's height); the straight-down slam is its own gated candidate, CRATER SLAM. Heights are in body heights (_bh, 1 bh is 75 units) unless a key says units. Version field: schema. Policy: every key required, objects closed except keys starting with an underscore. Orders (lowDeg at most highDeg, lowBh below highBh) and the downward direction of CRATER SLAM and the upward direction of UPPERCUT are checked by tools/lib/xref-fight.js (launch-order, launch-direction).

drive.description: The SLAM DOWN drive: the angle below level is lowDeg at lowBh or lower, rising evenly to highDeg at highBh and above.

uppercut.description: The UPPERCUT launch direction: ux along the launcher's facing (0 or more), uy up (above 0). The slam lever: the direction was in the planner's code before.

ux.description: Along the launcher's facing; 0 or more.

craterSlam.description: The gated CRATER SLAM candidate: the old straight-down vector (ux, uy) and the two gates that offer it.

ux.description: Along the launcher's facing; 0 or more.

below.description: Gate 1, a rival directly below: the target is within sideBh sideways of the launcher and at least dropBh lower.

setPiece.description: Gate 2, the crater set piece: the launcher is at minTier or above, and throws at most one CRATER SLAM in everySec seconds of match time.

score.description: Planner score points: base + perTier x tier, + high when the target is over highAlt up.

highAlt.description: The target's height above the ground in units (not body heights).
